answer: Copy-paste identities cannot hold one licensed skip path. For 52 minutes the applicant stakes 41.1 POA and draws mast W3 on the west jetty. They transmit a 7.05 MHz pulse and log 15 ionospheric echo delays while a 3.6 kg ferrous coil stays at 18-22 C; peers recompute delays from the public ionosonde at KM19, and each hop must stay within 12 us, not a lab-flat file. A second W3 booking, or a delay series within 4 us RMSE of another ticket, slashes 41.1 POA and voids both seats. If a solar flare blanks the F-layer before pulse 6, 20.4 POA is refunded and W3 stays dark 26 hours with a new serial.
